name: Wells Fargo Autograph Journey℠ Card

apr.notes: Purchase APR is 19.49%, 25.49%, or 28.49%, based on creditworthiness; APRs vary with the market based on the U.S. Prime Rate.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign currency conversion / foreign transaction fee is none per Wells Fargo Important Credit Terms.

credit_required.notes: Credit card is subject to credit qualification.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem Wells Fargo Rewards for travel, Pay with Rewards, eligible purchases, gift cards, account credits, or points transfers; redemption values vary by option.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 60,000 bonus points after spending $4,000 in purchases in the first 3 months; Wells Fargo markets this as $600 toward your next trip.

benefits.title: $50 annual airline statement credit
benefits.description: One-time $50 statement credit each year after the card is used for the first airline purchase of at least $50.

benefits.title: Worldwide Automatic Common Carrier Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Travel Accident Insurance protection of up to $1,000,000 when an airline or other common carrier ticket is purchased with the eligible card.

benefits.title: Lost Baggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 in luggage reimbursement per trip if bags are lost due to theft or misdirection by a common carrier while traveling.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement of up to $15,000 for eligible lodging, flights, and activities if a trip paid with the eligible card is canceled or interrupted for a covered reason.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Reimbursement for covered rental car damage or theft when the rental is paid for with the eligible card and coverage from the rental company is declined.

benefits.title: Cellular Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $1,000 of cell phone protection against damage, theft, or unintended separation, subject to a $25 deductible.

benefits.title: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services
benefits.description: Available for covered Wells Fargo cardholders. Count on emergency assistance while traveling anywhere in the world.

benefits.title: Roadside Dispatch®
benefits.description: Available whenever you're in need of a tow - for eligible Wells Fargo cardholders 24/7 with no membership required.

benefits.title: Visa Signature Concierge Services
benefits.description: Complimentary 24/7 Visa Signature Concierge Services for help with tickets, travel, dining reservations, and more.

benefits.title: Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection
benefits.description: Access to a premium collection of benefits at participating Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection properties.

notes: Distinct from the no-annual-fee Wells Fargo Autograph Card; Autograph Journey has a $95 annual fee and travel-focused earn rates.
